newsitem.title: USA: NYCE FCOJ open interest reaches new record high.
newsitem.headline: NYCE FCOJ open interest reaches new record high.

text.p: Open interest on Frozen Concentrated Orange Juice (FCOJ) futures reached a new all-time high of 36,791 lots as of the close of business June 23, the New York Cotton Exchange said on Tuesday.
Prior to yesterday's high, the previous record level of open interest was 32,944 lots, set on April 19, 1995.
Through May 1997, average daily trading volume for FCOJ futures was 3,720 contracts, a 30 percent increase over the same year-ago period.
